CMCPvP.notes: CMCPVP 1.0.15: real 3D map previews (a true scaled copy of each arena), invisible walls built first on every arena and FFA map, roomy see-through PvP HQ capsule with a trapdoor floor and shattering glass, 4 new masterpiece arenas (Dragonspire Keep, Koi Shrine Summit, Corsair Harbor, Stormpeak Sanctuary), new main buildings for Frostfang, Stonewatch, Ember Citadel and Obsidian Forge, a ruined Titan Colosseum, sculpted trees everywhere, 7 lookalike maps retired

PracticePvP.notes: Fix: the SMP nether and end count as part of the SMP again, so /rtp, /tpa, /tpahere, /home, /sethome, /back, /spectate, claims and the SMP rules all work there
